description: Fetch real-time stock and cryptocurrency market data. Supports major stocks (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL) and crypto (BTC, ETH, SOL). Returns price, daily change, volume, and market cap. Data from Yahoo Finance (stocks) and CoinGecko (crypto).

symbol.description: Ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL for stocks; BTC, ETH, SOL for crypto)

type.description: Asset type. "auto" detects based on symbol. Use "stock" or "crypto" to force.

name: query_stocks
